Rahul Gandhi Launches 'Satyagraha' Platform to Connect Protests

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has launched a new platform named 'Satyagraha' aimed at connecting and mapping various protests across India. The initiative seeks to bring together different movements under a unified umbrella. The platform's launch was announced with the slogan 'Sangharsh Jodo, Bharat Jodo' (Connect Struggles, Connect India).
